newsitem.title: GERMANY: Holiday airline Hapag-Lloyd Flug joins IAT.
newsitem.headline: Holiday airline Hapag-Lloyd Flug joins IAT.

text.p: Germany holiday airline Hapag-Lloyd Flug said it has joined the International Air Transport Association (IATA).

The airline, the in-house carrier of transport and travel company Hapag-Lloyd AG, said it operated scheduled services from 15 German airports, Basel-Mulhouse and Luxembourg to 40 tourist destinations in the Mediterranean, Canary Islands, Portugal and the Dominican Republic.
IATA has more than 220 member airlines in 130 countries and represents 98 percent of the world scheduled flight market, it added.
